WRITE IN SECONDS

· Light formatting like headings and lists, and full keyboard shortcuts on Mac
· Optionally add the weather, the address and your mood

VOICE AND PHOTOS

FIND IT LATER

EVERY DAY COUNTS

YOUR SPACE

9 LANGUAGES
English, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 日本語, 한국어, Español, Deutsch, Français and Português (Brasil). Choose the interface language in Settings — it applies immediately — or follow the system. Dates and weather descriptions follow the interface language.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

OPTIONAL AI REFLECTIONS
· After you write, get a response to your entry, or a summary of recent entries

6762338774.releaseNotes:
Improvements:

- Smoother food search: the complete food catalog now has a multilingual search index with debounced input and cancellation of outdated searches. Category filters and name matching are more accurate, while exact and prefix matches for whole foods appear first, reducing typing lag.
- Caffeine now syncs to Apple Health: adding coffee on iPhone or Apple Watch syncs the coffee, linked meal, water and caffeine records. Deletion removes only the corresponding samples written by the App, reducing duplicates without deleting other apps' data.
- More consistent wrist temperature and calories on Apple Watch: the watch prioritizes phone-provided daily summaries, personal baselines and 60 days of wrist-temperature history, falling back to local Apple Health data when needed. Calorie goals and active-energy calculations now match the phone too.
- No repeated hydration reminders after reaching your goal: remaining reminders for the day are cancelled and a single completion message is sent. Regular reminders resume if you delete water entries or raise your goal, while quiet hours remain respected.
- More accurate wrist-temperature baselines: deviation and sustained-rise insights now share your personal historical baseline. When there is not enough valid history, the App clearly shows that no baseline is available instead of presenting misleading comparisons based on a target or a few nightly samples.
- Better regional AI availability: AI entry points follow the App Store region and are hidden where the feature is unavailable. Photo recognition and the existing health assessments in Overview remain unaffected.

Bug Fixes:

- Overview loading and workout-route fixes: revised data queries for initial loading, historical dates, detail views and date sheets. Today's route refreshes immediately after a workout, stale requests cannot overwrite a newer date, and new health-data diagnostics help investigate remaining device-specific loading issues.
- Interactive heart-rate charts: touch or drag across the all-day heart-rate graph in Heart Health to inspect a specific time with a vertical guide, compare today's and yesterday's values, and feel light haptic feedback as the selected interval changes.
- Diet-view refinements and stability: the manual-add sheet is taller so its title stays visible, and a crash that could occur when opening diet statistics has been fixed.
- Startup and snore-monitoring stability: guarded against a snore analyzer crash after an audio-service reset, and fixed a date comparison in Overview assessments that could cause a cold-launch crash on some system versions.
- Watch and route details: care timelines now retain 30 days of events with their related reactions. Temperature and humidity on today's route card stay on one line instead of wrapping into each other.
6762338774.description:
Healthcare is an Apple Intelligence-powered personal health companion that helps you manage your physical and mental wellbeing.

  Dashboard: At-a-glance view of 20 health metrics including steps, sleep, water, exercise, heart rate, blood oxygen, wrist temperature, and HRV. A large progress ring shows daily goal completion, with a 7-day mini-ring strip for trend tracking. Confetti celebrates perfect days.

  Discipline Habits: Six life categories (Learning, Life, Parenting, Pets, Social, Work) with 60 preset activities and custom options. Dual concentric rings display habit and diet progress simultaneously. Gantt timeline shows daily activity schedule, and weekly reports summarize achievements. Category completion triggers exclusive Lottie celebration animations.

  Diet Tracking: Log breakfast, lunch, and dinner with an 80+ food database covering 22 nutrients (calories, protein, carbs, fat, fiber, vitamins, minerals). All 39 dietary nutrients automatically sync to Apple Health. A 7-day calorie trend curve compares intake versus expenditure.

  AI Daily Analysis: Every night at 8 PM, a smart analysis report is generated based on your day's habits and diet data, streamed by MiniMax M2.7 with personalized insights and recommendations.

  Health Assistant: An AI chatbot that answers health questions, generates daily schedules, and accesses real-time weather and health knowledge.

  Mood Tracking: 10-level mood recording with notes. A 30-day curve and calendar view track emotional patterns, with a Mood x HRV cross-analysis chart.

  Challenges & Badges: 19 seasonal sports challenges with rotating seasonal artwork and poetry. Earn badges for completion. CloudKit leaderboards and friend competition.

  Buddy Pets: Capture a procedurally generated virtual pet daily by completing 5 habits. Visit landmarks to find rare Golden Buddies. A gallery displays all collected buddies with GIF sharing.

  Sleep Analysis: Sleep stage hypnogram, sleeping heart rate curve, blood oxygen during sleep, and composite quality score.

  Snore Detection: Real-time microphone analysis with per-stage snore severity rings. Audio clip playback. Auto sleep stage estimation without Apple Watch.

  Coffee & Water Tracking: Log coffee with caffeine metabolism curve and safe bedtime alerts. Water intake with time-distribution charts and hydration scoring.

  Widget: iOS home screen widget showing daily habit progress.

  Multi-language: Chinese Simplified, Chinese Traditional, English, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French, German.

Local Audio Books plays the audiobooks you own, free classics in eight languages, and podcasts that just play.

EVERYTHING ON ONE SCREEN

BUILT FOR LONG LISTENS

6834076393.description:
Most screen time tools count minutes. Minutes say nothing about whether the time was worth it.

Good Terms puts a five-second check-in in front of the apps you choose to limit. Before you go in, it asks how you feel and what you are looking for. If you are still there when your time runs out, it asks how you feel now, and whether you found it.

Over time you see which sessions leave you better off and which leave you worse, in your own data.

HOW IT WORKS
• Choose the apps you want a pause in front of: two for free, or any number and whole categories with Plus.
• Open one and you get a check-in: a mood from Low to Great, and what you are hoping to find.
• Unlock just that app for 5, 15 or 30 minutes.
• Still there when time is up? One more question: how do you feel now?

INSIGHTS FROM YOUR OWN SESSIONS
• Which apps lift your mood and which drain it.
• A grid of every app by time of day, so you can see that the late-night scroll is the one that costs you.
• How often you found what you came for.
• A one-line reminder at each check-in, drawn from your most recent sessions: "Your last 18 sessions here at this time of day ended 1.9 lower on average."
• Nothing is shown until it rests on at least 10 completed sessions.

GENTLE OR FIRM
• Gentle: you can always get in after a check-in, and you can skip it.
• Firm: a daily budget you set in advance, no skipping, and one emergency pass a week.

KIND, NOT STRICT
Good Terms asks and reflects back. It never scolds, and every limit is one you set and can change.

A SKY THAT FOLLOWS YOUR DAY
The app is a paper landscape that changes with the clock: a morning sun, a clear midday, a dusky evening and a night sky. Your mood moves the sun.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account and no sign-in.
• No ads and no tracking.
• Your check-ins are stored on your device. Nothing is sent to us.
• If you join a family, only your weekly totals are shared, through your own iCloud.
• Delete your check-in history at any time, in Limits.
• Good Terms uses Apple's Screen Time to lock the apps you choose. It never sees what you do inside any app.

FOR FAMILIES
• Set Good Terms up on a child's phone with a parent's approval, and keep the limits behind a parent code.
• Together shows each person's week: minutes unlocked, and how often they moved on when time ran out. A parent's numbers are there too.
• Send a cheer when someone does well.
• Moods stay private unless someone chooses to share theirs.

GOOD TERMS PLUS
Good Terms is free for two apps. Plus covers as many apps as you like and whole categories, lets you start a family, and shows each other's week and cheers. One purchase covers your Family Sharing group. Monthly, yearly or a one-time purchase. Subscriptions renew until cancelled in your Apple Account settings.
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy policy: https://hirocloud.com/good-terms/privacy

Good Terms is not a medical product and does not diagnose or treat any condition.

Requires iOS 26 or later and Screen Time access.

A little water toy. A whole ocean of puzzles.

Ringo brings the classic water-ring toy to your iPhone and iPad. Press the two water jets to lift colourful hoops, steer them through the current, then let them settle over the pegs. A gentle correction can make all the difference.

PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE
Play the first 30 Classic tides free. Unlock all 2,000 tides across 80 chapters with Ringo Pro, an optional one-time purchase. Choose any tide with Pro, or follow the journey through obstacles, drifting pegs and floating targets. Return to earn more stars by improving your time and using fewer bursts.

FIND YOUR FAVOURITE WAY TO PLAY
• Quick Sets: three short rounds with a choice of focus.
• Time Attack: land as many rings as you can in 60 seconds.
• Zen: keep the rings flowing without a clock.
• Precision: twelve trials with a limited number of bursts.
• Daily Tide: a shared daily puzzle with your best saved on this device.

MAKE IT YOUR OWN
Choose Bubble Poles, Hover Pods or Crystal Spires. Enjoy underwater scenery, water sounds and haptic feedback. Turn on optional tilt and shake controls, or play entirely with the two buttons.

No ads. No subscription. No app account required. Play offline, with progress and preferences saved on each device. An internet connection is needed to purchase, restore or redeem Ringo Pro. Progress does not sync between devices.

Made for iPhone and iPad, with portrait and landscape play on iPad.

Press, steer, release — and watch the rings find their place.

6751436384.description:
Your cycle, logged deeply with details. Owned completely.

Petals is a private period tracker that keeps your data on your phone, ALWAYS. No internet needed. No account. No one can see your information, ever.

YOUR DATA STAYS ON YOUR PHONE.

Most period apps send your personal health information to their servers. Petals doesn't. Everything you log stays on your iPhone. There are no Petals servers. Your cycle is yours, and only YOURS.

SWITCH FROM ANY APP IN SECONDS.

Already tracking in Apple Health, Flo, or Clue? Bring your full menstrual history into Petals in one tap. You can import your period dates, flow, spotting and symptoms data directly from Apple Health and add it to your Petals timeline. No manual re-entry, no starting from scratch. Import once, or repeat anytime to pull in new data. Your Apple Health data stays exactly where it is. Petals just reads it.

TRACK 52 SIGNALS. UNDERSTAND YOUR BODY.

- Period & flow: mark period days, log how heavy your flow is, blood colour, clots and spotting

- Body signals: cramps, discharge, headaches, nausea, acne, brain fog, breast tenderness and more

- Lifestyle:  stress, sleep, travel, workouts, caffeine and more

- Vitals:  temperature, blood pressure, heart rate, weight and more

- Well-being:  mood, energy, cravings, focus, self-care and more

For each signal, you can add details like how bad it is, where it hurts, and what time it happened. Nothing gets missed.

REMINDERS THAT STAY QUIET.
Many period apps send cringy tips and weird messages you never asked for. Petals doesn’t. You choose what to be reminded about:

- Upcoming period: get a period reminder on the first expected day or a few days before
- Late period: a gentle nudge if your period is later than expected
- Signal logging: a reminder to log how you feel

Pick the time. Pick how often. Turn any reminder off anytime. Reminders are free and work offline.

WRITE YOUR OWN NOTIFICATION MESSAGE.
Don’t want family, friends, or coworkers to see “period reminder” on your screen?  Write your own, like “My parcel is on the way”. Your lock screen shows only your words. Only you will know what it means.

PREDICTIONS THAT LEARN FROM YOU
Petals predicts your next period using your own cycle history; not an average from someone else's data. You can also set your own cycle length manually if you prefer. Your body, your rules.

SIMPLE TO USE. NOT OVERWHELMING
Petals is designed to be simple, not overwhelming. Pick the signals you're feeling, add the details, and you're done in under a minute. Clean design, no clutter.

FIND ANY LOG IN SECONDS.
Every signal you've ever logged is saved in a searchable list. Tap any entry to see the full details.  Next time your doctor asks about your symptoms, everything is right there on your phone.

BACK UP WHEN YOU WANT.
Upgrade to Premium to turn on automatic iCloud backup - your data goes to your personal iCloud, not ours. You can also save a backup file yourself and keep it anywhere you like.

Premium includes: automatic iCloud backup and manual export.

Log everything and use all reminders for free, forever.

Download Petals today. Track your cycle privately, in detail, on your own terms.

6825604929.description:
What Matters, at a Glance.

Your grocery list is buried in an app somewhere. Your seat and gate are in a booking screenshot. The code for the pickup locker is sitting in a text you can't find. When the moment comes, none of it is ever at hand.

Floaty keeps the next thing you need on your Lock Screen. No unlocking, no hunting through apps—just lift your phone to see it, and get it done right there.

ONE BOARD FOR EVERYTHING THAT MATTERS NOW

• To-dos: Your headline plus checklist progress; check items off as you go, and finishing the last one completes the whole to-do 
• Flights: Flight number, terminals, seat and gate in a clean, ticket-style layout—no more digging through booking screenshots 
• Train tickets: Train number, departure and arrival, seat and gate, all on one ticket-style card 
• Package & locker codes: Grouped by pickup place so you see every code at once—big and readable when you walk up

Tap through items right on the Lock Screen and mark them done with a tap. Finish one, and the next one floats into view.

AUTO-ADD FROM TEXTS, NOTIFICATIONS, AND EMAIL (PRO)

No more copying codes and trip details by hand.
